name: Excel Industries Limited
summary: Excel Industries Limited commits to embedding sustainability across its supply chain through responsible sourcing, ethical governance, and supplier engagement. The policy emphasizes environmental protection, social responsibility, and continuous improvement in procurement practices.
tagline: Sustainable sourcing for a cleaner, fairer value chain.

company.name: Excel Industries Limited
company.address: 184/87, S.V. Road, Jogeshwari (W), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400102, India

declaration.preface: Excel Industries Ltd. is committed to integrating sustainability principles across its supply chain to minimize environmental impacts, ensure responsible social practices, and contribute to ethical business operations.
declaration.declaration: The company is committed to promoting sustainable procurement practices that foster responsible sourcing, ethical business conduct, and social responsibility throughout its supply chain.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all activities related to the manufacture, scale-up and supply of industrial chemicals, agrochemical intermediates, specialty chemicals, polymer intermediates, and pharmaceutical products, and to all business units, employees, contractors, stakeholders, external providers, and operating sites of Excel Industries Limited.

Supplier Environmental Practices: Adopt energy-efficient processes and reduce greenhouse gas emissions through renewable energy, energy conservation, and emission control strategies.
Minimize waste generation, encourage recycling and reuse, and responsibly manage hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
Monitor and reduce water consumption and ensure wastewater is treated and discharged according to environmental regulations.
Design processes to minimize air emissions and comply with local air quality standards.
Safely handle, store, and dispose of chemicals in compliance with local and international safety and environmental guidelines.
Avoid sourcing from environmentally sensitive areas and protect ecosystems by promoting biodiversity conservation.
Supplier Social Practices: Maintain safe working conditions by following occupational health and safety regulations.
Adhere to fair labor practices, including fair wages, reasonable working hours, and non-discriminatory work environments.
Comply with laws prohibiting child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking.
Foster inclusive work environments that promote diversity and equal opportunity.
Offer training and career development opportunities to improve employee skills and job satisfaction.
Supplier Ethics & Governance: Implement anti-corruption measures to prevent bribery and unethical business dealings.
Protect confidential data, intellectual property, and sensitive business information throughout the supply chain.
Commitment to Health, Safety, and Sustai: Work with suppliers who demonstrate leadership in health and safety, environmental responsibility, and social sustainability.
Comply with local, national, and international regulations related to health, safety, and environmental protection.
Implement continuous improvement strategies for sustainability.

targets.target: Ensure 100% of strategic suppliers sign and comply with Excel’s Supplier Code of Conduct.
Conduct annual supplier ESG self-assessments covering 100% of Tier-1 suppliers.
Conduct on-site ESG audits for 100% of high-risk suppliers every year.
Ensure 100% of procurement employees and key suppliers receive ESG training annually.
Achieve zero incidents of major supplier non-compliance with sustainability or ethical requirements.
Reduce total supply chain Scope 3 GHG emissions by 15% compared to the 2021 baseline.
Achieve 10% reduction in supplier water consumption and ensure 100% wastewater treatment compliance.
Reduce waste generation by 10% and achieve a 20% recycling/reuse rate across supplier operations.
Ensure 25% of raw material procurement comes from sustainable or recycled sources.
Ensure 100% of key suppliers comply with local and national air quality regulations.
Ensure 100% supplier compliance with fair labor, human rights, and non-discrimination laws.
Maintain zero incidents of child labor or forced labor in the supply chain.
Ensure 100% of supplier workplaces provide safe and healthy working conditions.
Increase female participation in supplier workforce by 10% across key supplier facilities.
Achieve zero incidents of corruption, bribery, or anti-competitive practices across the supply chain.
Conduct due-diligence assessments for 100% of new suppliers before onboarding.
Maintain 100% data protection compliance among all suppliers handling confidential or sensitive information.
Integrate ethical performance metrics into supplier evaluation and renewal processes.
Ensure 100% of suppliers comply with occupational health and safety regulations.
Achieve zero fatalities or major work-related injuries across supplier operations.
Ensure 100% supplier compliance with Excel’s sustainability and EHS improvement initiatives.

responsibilities.duty: Provide oversight of the Sustainable Procurement Policy and performance.
Review the policy monthly at all sites, assess progress, make amendments as required, evaluate procurement performance metrics and KPIs, and ensure cross-functional coordination.
Manage supplier relationships, ensure adherence to the policy, and integrate sustainability criteria into procurement processes.
Integrate sustainable procurement policy and practices within their units.
Ensure departmental compliance with sustainable procurement policies and report progress and issues to the Procurement Department.
Adhere to the policy, ensure compliance in supplier selection, and report concerns or violations.

policy.monitoring: Supplier performance is regularly assessed through visits, audits, reviews, sustainability audits, feedback, and other suitable mechanisms. Non-compliances are reviewed and may result in corrective actions or termination of business relationships. Performance reporting is made to the MRM Committee every six months, and the Board of Directors and stakeholders review performance through the BRSR and Annual Sustainability Report yearly.
policy.reviewMechanism: The policy is reviewed monthly at all sites during the Management Review Meeting (MRM) committee, with six-monthly performance reporting to the MRM Committee and yearly review through the Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) and Annual Sustainability Report (ASR).
